findings.rationale: False positive: this private send helper has only settlement and refund callers. Settlement pays the factory wallet selected by the artist/platform-signed profile using exactly the credited highest bid after consuming escrow. Refunds spend only msg.sender credit, which is zeroed before calling that claimant's chosen destination. Both callers are nonReentrant and failed sends revert accounting.
findings.owner: Protocol maintainers and independent security reviewers

findings.rationale: False positive: `amount == 0` is an exact sentinel for the absence of releasable entitlement, not a manipulable balance target. The branch reverts before release-ledger, transfer, or observation effects; every positive amount follows the same CEI release path. The equality is required to distinguish no claim from the smallest valid one-wei claim.
findings.owner: Protocol maintainers and independent security reviewers
required_proof: Source evidence: smart-contracts/domains/revenue/StreamSplitWallet.sol release computes the cumulative entitlement first, then uses `amount == 0` only to reject a no-op before any state mutation or external call.

Focused executable evidence: test/unit/revenue/StreamSplitWallet.t.sol::testReleaseZeroSentinelRevertsAndPositiveBoundaryReleases proves exact zero reverts without effects and the adjacent one-wei value releases successfully.
Accounting evidence: test/unit/revenue/StreamSplitWallet.t.sol::testNativeAccountingInvariantsAcrossReceiptReleaseAndSyncRounds proves positive releases preserve cumulative entitlement conservation.

findings.rationale: False positive: `observed == previous` is the intentional unchanged high-water-mark branch after the function has already rejected every decrease. Returning without a duplicate event is the specified behavior; any increase updates the stored observation and emits `AssetSynced`, so equality cannot bypass a required state transition.
findings.owner: Protocol maintainers and independent security reviewers
required_proof: Source evidence: smart-contracts/domains/revenue/StreamSplitWallet.sol _recordObservation initializes once, rejects `observed < previous`, returns only for exact equality, and records every `observed > previous` increase.

Focused executable evidence: test/unit/revenue/StreamSplitWallet.t.sol::testSyncAssetRecordsInitializationIncreaseAndSkipsUnchangedObservations covers first-zero initialization, unchanged zero, increase, and unchanged positive observations with exact event assertions.
Negative-boundary evidence: test/unit/revenue/StreamSplitWallet.t.sol::testSyncAssetRejectsDecreasingObservedReceipts proves the immediately lower branch reverts with the retained high-water mark.

findings.rationale: False positive for accepted user funds: the payable provider ABI is required by the shared interface, but requestEntropy rejects every nonzero msg.value and there is no receive or fallback entry point. findings.owner: Protocol maintainers and independent security reviewers

findings.rationale: False positive: createAuction holds the nonReentrant guard, consumes the signed authorization nonce before the manager interaction, and verifies actual Core custody plus returned token IDs before storing the auction. All auction mutations share the guard. The mint receiver callback is view-only and requires the exact Core, a mint from zero, and the active mint window.
findings.owner: Protocol maintainers and independent security reviewers

findings.rationale: False positive: requestEntropy, fulfillment, and retained-result retry share the nonReentrant guard. A synchronous upstream callback cannot enter fulfillment while the request is being established. The upstream request ID must be known before the binding is stored; unknown or duplicate IDs cannot install a result. The immutable Chainlink coordinator remains an explicit trusted dependency.
findings.owner: Protocol maintainers and independent security reviewers
required_proof: smart-contracts/domains/entropy/StreamEntropyProviderVRF.sol:190-230,244-269 guards request, fulfillment, and retry; the detector cross-function target keyToVrfRequest is a view getter.

test/unit/entropy/StreamEntropyProviderVRF.t.sol:testV25RequestIdentityAuthenticationAndDuplicateCallback and testRevertOutOfGasAndMalformedResponseRetainIdenticalRandomness cover identity and retry boundaries.

findings.rationale: False positive: initializeGenesis is nonReentrant, accepts only the immutable bootstrap authority and exact committed plan, and consumes genesisInitialized before interactions. Each action becomes EXECUTED before target calls; nested scheduling is blocked while executing. Self-only per-call transition contexts protect governed mutations. Completion requires sealing and no pending actions; failure reverts the full initialization.
findings.owner: Protocol maintainers and independent security reviewers
required_proof: smart-contracts/domains/governance/StreamGovernanceExecutor.sol:138-147,168-195,1048,1384 checks immutable authority/plan and guards one-shot scheduling and execution.

test/unit/governance/StreamGenesisInitializer.t.sol covers unauthorized initialization, changed calldata, prepared failure/retry, complete seal, and irrevocably closed initialization; test/current/StreamCurrentStack.t.sol exercises the actual initialized product stack.

findings.rationale: False positive: provider status, raw hash, and delivered flag are intentionally unused. Authorized transition, requested state, elapsed timeout, exact bound request key, and absence of received randomness are the necessary stale predicates. Retained output prevents marking stale regardless of delivery status.
findings.owner: Protocol maintainers and independent security reviewers
required_proof: smart-contracts/domains/entropy/StreamEntropyCoordinator.sol:487-500 enforces timeout, exact request binding, and !rawRandomnessReceived.

test/unit/entropy/StreamEntropyMetadata.t.sol:testStaleAndFailureStatesDoNotAuthorizeReroll and testRevokedProviderRetainsOutputAndCanDeliverSameResultAfterRestore cover no-reroll and retained-output rejection.

findings.rationale: False positive: the transition requires the provider status to be TERMINAL_FAILED, the exact bound request key, and no received randomness. Under these predicates the omitted raw hash and delivered flag cannot authorize a transition or change the retained-output policy.
findings.owner: Protocol maintainers and independent security reviewers
required_proof: smart-contracts/domains/entropy/StreamEntropyCoordinator.sol:503-514 checks exact terminal failure and rejects retained randomness.

test/unit/entropy/StreamEntropyMetadata.t.sol:testStaleAndFailureStatesDoNotAuthorizeReroll and testRevokedProviderRetainsOutputAndCanDeliverSameResultAfterRestore cover terminal and retained-result behavior.
